title: genista sericea subsp. rigida
intro: Genista sericea subsp. rigida, commonly known as a type of shrub within the pea family, is a plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Genista sericea subsp. rigida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
